STILLROOT'S SONG   |   PLAYER HANDOUT

LUCID

A fact you have held onto. A name you have kept.

Spend this token to succeed on a save against the adventure's Terror or memory illusion, recall a true fact your character has learned, or shape one minor dream detail using an established memory.

A handrail. A familiar tool. A light. A route you marked.

It cannot invent unlimited power or erase another character's choices.

Maximum three tokens held. Your actual notes do not require a token to consult.
